'''Buzzbeak''' is a [[Lightning]] type [[Tank]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Sparkeet]] at 6 bronze stars and into [[Toucanzam]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Often taken for a foodie because of the size of that mouth, Buzzbeak's appetite is actually quite small. That said, it is a convenient hiding place for odd things... like the [[NPCs#Doctor Looney|Doctor]]'s glasses that have gone missing."

Buzzbeak is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
TBA

== Evolution Trial ==
Buzzbeak's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Toucanzam]] you need to complete the following two tasks:
* Feed Buzzbeak to increase stats 3 times.
* Play [[Treasure Hunt]] (dig up 70 treasure) or [[Cozy Farm]] (use x4200 fertilizer).

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "A fully charged Buzzbeak can power 3 [[Voltfawn]]s for a week, or 10 Phantom Storms for [[Voltverine]]."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Inspires allies with song. While singing, Buzzbeak generates electricity from the body, and intense performances may form electric rings nearby."
